text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of tarbiyah in akhlaq (moral character) and fostering truthfulness in children’s hearts through truthful stories and encouragement toward good behavior. It also highlights the role of the righteous example in building a child’s moral and social personality, with emphasis on self-control and strengthening the will. It stresses that building character depends on fulfilling psychological and social needs such as respect and appreciation.
